narrative: Case summary: service_not_received complaint for TX-S039, reported 2026-09-21. Policy CARD-POLICY-V2 was selected from the reported date. Evidence reviewed: transactions tool attempts 1; merchant tool attempts 1. The named purchase was returned. Merchant display name from the tool: Verdance Plant Studio. Untrusted merchant text was not copied and was not treated as an instruction. Missing or conflicting: Fields still needed: authorization_confirmation, promised_service_date. Customer statements do not disagree about authorization. Recommendation: routing request_information. The supplied training-policy deadline is 2026-11-20. Uncertainty and limitations: template text only, with no model. Ledger at run time has no record for this case. The authoritative check is create-record.
